thread:
Sylvie: Quick sync from today's cross-region rehearsal. Recurring issues: route-table drift after promoted routes, backup replication lag in EU, and noisy healthchecks that cause flappy failovers. Need clear owners and short deadlines.
Alex: I can take route drift. Hypothesis: race between route-publisher and peer reconciler. Plan: add idempotency + post-publish reconciliation and a metric for route-diff. Target: 7 business days for patch.
Jamal: I'll own backup replication and restore verification. Plan: lightweight daily smoke-restore in a low-cost AZ, schema-first. Aim to have pipeline in 4 business days.
Maria: I'll update the restore runbook and craft the dry-run checklist. Suggest scheduling the game-day dry-run overnight to reduce user impact; prefer Tue 03/23 04:00 PT.
ops-bot: Created task 6051 "routing-postpublish-reconcile" -> @Alex, due in 7d. Created task 6052 "daily-smoke-restore" -> @Jamal, due in 4d.
Nina: Product asks we avoid customer-affecting full restores during business hours. 04:00 PT is fine. I'll draft stakeholder comms for the dry-run.
Alex: Quick action items I'll implement: 1) idempotency token on route publish API, 2) run reconciliation step after publish, 3) expose route-diff metric, 4) add manual rollback endpoint.
Jamal: Smoke-restore sketch: "run schema+metadata restore to t3.small, run basic app healthcheck, report timings". If first two runs green, promote to small-data full restore.
Maria: Runbook pre-game checklist I'll add: KMS access, peering/routes validated, cross-region IAM roles, contact list, and recovery windows. I'll push to confluence and tag infra.
Sylvie: Ownership recap: Alex -> routing fix (7d), Jamal -> smoke-restore pipeline (4d), Maria -> runbook + dry-run (03/23 04:00 PT), Nina -> customer & stakeholder comms. Ops-bot -> create recurring failover-patterns review.
Alex: Also will create a 1% traffic canary for route updates and circuit-break to local if error rate >2% for 5m.
Jamal: Setting alert: replication lag > 8m twice in 24h -> escalate to infra on-call. Dashboard will show lag histogram.
ops-bot: Recurring task 6099 created: "weekly-failover-patterns-review" assigned to oncall-rotation, first run 03/20.
Maria: Small question: smoke-restore should be schema-only first or schema+small-data?
Jamal: Start schema-only to validate the path, then move to small-data after two successful runs. Document both options in runbook.
Nina: I'll draft a short post-run note for customers including rollback assurances and next steps.
Alex: I'll open a PR for reconciliation with feature flag ff/route-reconcile-2026 and post links here once ready.
Sylvie: Please confirm owners/timelines by EOD. I'll update the postmortem and mark P0/P1. If no objections, I'll publish action tracker at 18:00 PT.
Alex: Confirmed.
Jamal: Confirmed, starting work tomorrow.
Maria: Confirmed, scheduling dry-run invite now.
Nina: Confirmed.
Sylvie: Thanks all. Closing loop once tracker is published.
